title: Verification record says 14 unit tests; the suite runs 26
symptom: docs/verification.md line 14 records 'Unit | npm run unit | PASS (14 tests)'. The command prints 26 passed across 4 files (shared/fixtures 4, shared/api 8, scanner/src/rules 7, scanner/src/cli 7), so the only dated unit count in the repo is 12 short. It also names the scanner half only: 14 = 7 + 7, as if shared/ did not run.
expected: The verification record states the count the command prints: 26 tests across 4 files.
fix_commit: working tree (uncommitted); docs/verification.md unit row corrected to the measured 26
regression_test: manual: re-run npm run unit and compare its printed count with the row
root_cause: The row was written when only the scanner's two suites existed; eb91285 added a 7th rule test and the count moved to 26 without the row being re-read. The author counted the scanner suites only, so the shared/fixtures and shared/api suites were never in the number.
bench_note: A one-line prose count fix; a hidden test could assert the doc matches the suite's printed count, which is the same shape as the docs-answer da-verification-count-drift task already in Fix Bench.
notes: Found during the 2026-11-19 readiness sweep of all thirteen pieces, after the final audit. Every other unit/test count in the six pieces matched its measured value.
